skills.name: dbsnp_database
skills.title: dbsnp database
skills.description: Use when you want to look up, map, and search for short genetic variants (SNPs, indels) in NCBI's dbSNP database. Resolves between rsIDs, genomic coordinates in VCF format, and HGVS strings. For an rsID, returns variant type, gene associations, clinical significance, allele frequencies, and genomic coordinates (GRCh38).

scripts.dbsnp_cli.py:
usage: dbsnp_cli.py [-h]
                    {get-variant,resolve-variant,resolve-rsid,resolve-hgvs,search-region}
                    ...

Query NCBI dbSNP via Variation Services and E-utilities.

positional arguments:
  {get-variant,resolve-variant,resolve-rsid,resolve-hgvs,search-region}
    get-variant         Retrieve the RefSNP record for a given rsID.
    resolve-variant     Find rsID(s) from VCF-style coordinates.
    resolve-rsid        Get genomic coordinates for an rsID.
    resolve-hgvs        Find rsID(s) from an HGVS expression.
    search-region       Find rsIDs within a chromosomal region.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: dbsnp_cli.py get-variant [-h] [--assembly ASSEMBLY] [--full] --output
                                OUTPUT
                                rsid
positional arguments:
  rsid                 RefSNP identifier (e.g. 268 or rs268).
options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --assembly ASSEMBLY  RefSeq assembly accession (default: GCF_000001405.40 =
                       GRCh38).
  --full               Return the complete raw RefSNP JSON payload. WARNING:
                       the full payload is typically 50-500 KB and can exceed
                       1 MB for clinically significant variants. Only use this
                       flag when you need fields not present in the
                       abbreviated output, for example: submission history,
                       full HGVS nomenclature across all transcripts, or
                       detailed population-level allele frequency breakdowns
                       by sub-population.
  --output OUTPUT      Output JSON file path.

  ref                  Reference allele.
  alts                 Alternate allele(s), comma-separated.
options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --assembly ASSEMBLY  RefSeq assembly accession (default: GCF_000001405.40).
